paras.text: D. Combine the following sentences by placing nouns and noun phrases in apposition.
paras.urdu: D. اسماء اور اسمی فقروں کو بدل (اپوزیشن) کے طور پر رکھ کر درج ذیل جملوں کو ملائیں۔
paras.pashto: D. د نومونو او نومي عبارتونو د بدل (اپوزیشن) په توګه په ایښودو لاندې جملې سره یوځای کړئ.

paras.text: 1. The first prime Minister of Pakistan was assassinated in 1951. He was Liaqat Ali Khan.
paras.urdu: 1. The first prime Minister of Pakistan was assassinated in 1951. He was Liaqat Ali Khan. — (پاکستان کے پہلے وزیرِ اعظم 1951 میں قتل کیے گئے۔ وہ لیاقت علی خان تھے۔)
paras.pashto: 1. The first prime Minister of Pakistan was assassinated in 1951. He was Liaqat Ali Khan. — (د پاکستان لومړی وزیر په 1951 کې ووژل شو. هغه لیاقت علي خان و.)

paras.text: 2. The river Indus' annual flow is about 243 cubic kilometres. It is the longest river of Pakistan.
paras.urdu: 2. The river Indus' annual flow is about 243 cubic kilometres. It is the longest river of Pakistan. — (دریائے سندھ کا سالانہ بہاؤ تقریباً 243 مکعب کلومیٹر ہے۔ یہ پاکستان کا سب سے لمبا دریا ہے۔)
paras.pashto: 2. The river Indus' annual flow is about 243 cubic kilometres. It is the longest river of Pakistan. — (د سند سیند کلنی بهیر شاوخوا 243 مکعب کیلومتره دی. دا د پاکستان تر ټولو اوږد سیند دی.)

paras.text: 3. Ustad Ahmad Lahori was the chief architect of Taj Mahal, in Agra, India. He hailed from Lahore.
paras.urdu: 3. Ustad Ahmad Lahori was the chief architect of Taj Mahal, in Agra, India. He hailed from Lahore. — (استاد احمد لاہوری آگرہ، بھارت میں تاج محل کے چیف معمار تھے۔ ان کا تعلق لاہور سے تھا۔)
paras.pashto: 3. Ustad Ahmad Lahori was the chief architect of Taj Mahal, in Agra, India. He hailed from Lahore. — (استاد احمد لاهوري د هند په اګره کې د تاج محل مشر معمار و. هغه د لاهور و.)

paras.text: 4. John Kennedy was known for his eloquent and inspirational speeches. He was a popular US President.
paras.urdu: 4. John Kennedy was known for his eloquent and inspirational speeches. He was a popular US President. — (جان کینیڈی اپنی فصیح اور ولولہ انگیز تقریروں کے لیے مشہور تھے۔ وہ ایک مقبول امریکی صدر تھے۔)
paras.pashto: 4. John Kennedy was known for his eloquent and inspirational speeches. He was a popular US President. — (جان کېنډي د خپلو فصیحو او الهام‌بښونکو ویناوو له امله مشهور و. هغه یو مشهور امریکایي ولسمشر و.)

paras.text: 5. The first country to recognise Pakistan is The Islamic republic of Iran. It is our neighbouring country.
paras.urdu: 5. The first country to recognise Pakistan is The Islamic republic of Iran. It is our neighbouring country. — (پاکستان کو تسلیم کرنے والا پہلا ملک اسلامی جمہوریہ ایران ہے۔ یہ ہمارا پڑوسی ملک ہے۔)
paras.pashto: 5. The first country to recognise Pakistan is The Islamic republic of Iran. It is our neighbouring country. — (لومړنی هېواد چې پاکستان یې په رسمیت وپېژانده د ایران اسلامي جمهوریت دی. دا زموږ ګاونډی هېواد دی.)

paras.text: 6. My uncle's car is the envoy of my friends. It is a sporty red convertible with bucket seats.
paras.urdu: 6. My uncle's car is the envoy of my friends. It is a sporty red convertible with bucket seats. — (میرے چچا کی گاڑی میرے دوستوں کی رشک ہے۔ یہ بکٹ سیٹوں والی ایک اسپورٹی سرخ کنورٹیبل ہے۔)

paras.text: 7. The chief surgeon took his daughter on a hospital tour. He is an expert in in organ transplant procedures.
paras.urdu: 7. The chief surgeon took his daughter on a hospital tour. He is an expert in in organ transplant procedures. — (چیف سرجن اپنی بیٹی کو ہسپتال کے دورے پر لے گئے۔ وہ اعضاء کی پیوند کاری کے ماہر ہیں۔)
paras.pashto: 7. The chief surgeon took his daughter on a hospital tour. He is an expert in in organ transplant procedures. — (مشر جراح خپله لور د روغتون لیدنې ته بوتله. هغه د غړو د پیوند په پروسیجرونو کې متخصص دی.)

paras.text: 8. The problem delayed the entire program. It was that you did not come on time.
paras.urdu: 8. The problem delayed the entire program. It was that you did not come on time. — (مسئلے نے پورے پروگرام میں تاخیر کر دی۔ وہ یہ تھا کہ تم وقت پر نہیں آئے۔)
paras.pashto: 8. The problem delayed the entire program. It was that you did not come on time. — (ستونزې ټول پروګرام وځنډاوه. هغه دا وه چې ته پر وخت رانه غلې.)

paras.text: 9. The worry troubles me too much. It is who we should invite.
paras.urdu: 9. The worry troubles me too much. It is who we should invite. — (فکر مجھے بہت پریشان کرتی ہے۔ وہ یہ ہے کہ ہمیں کسے مدعو کرنا چاہیے۔)
paras.pashto: 9. The worry troubles me too much. It is who we should invite. — (اندېښنه ما ډېر ځوروي. هغه دا ده چې باید چا ته بلنه ورکړو.)

paras.text: 10. Hamad is very dear to me. He is my younger brother.
paras.urdu: 10. Hamad is very dear to me. He is my younger brother. — (حماد مجھے بہت عزیز ہے۔ وہ میرا چھوٹا بھائی ہے۔)
paras.pashto: 10. Hamad is very dear to me. He is my younger brother. — (حماد ماته ډېر ګران دی. هغه زما کشر ورور دی.)

paras.text: E. Noun Clauses
paras.urdu: E. اسمیہ جملے (نَون کلازز)
paras.pashto: E. نومي جملې (نون کلازونه)

paras.text: Noun clauses are dependent clauses that can replace any noun in the sentence: subjects, objects, and/or subject complements. In all, there are five different functions that a noun clause can serve: subjects, direct objects, indirect objects, objects of the preposition and subject complements.
paras.urdu: اسمیہ جملے تابع جملے ہیں جو جملے میں کسی بھی اسم کی جگہ لے سکتے ہیں: فاعل، مفعول اور/یا فاعل کا تکملہ۔ مجموعی طور پر اسمیہ جملہ پانچ مختلف کام کر سکتا ہے: فاعل، مفعولِ صریح، مفعولِ غیر صریح، حرفِ جار کا مفعول اور فاعل کا تکملہ۔
paras.pashto: نومي جملې تابع جملې دي چې په جمله کې د هر نوم ځای نیولی شي: فاعل، مفعول او/یا د فاعل بشپړوونکی. په ټوله کې نومي جمله پنځه بېلابېلې دندې ترسره کولی شي: فاعل، مستقیم مفعول، غیرمستقیم مفعول، د اضافې مفعول او د فاعل بشپړوونکی.

sections.theory:
D. Combine the following sentences by placing nouns and noun phrases in apposition.

1. The first prime Minister of Pakistan was assassinated in 1951. He was Liaqat Ali Khan.

2. The river Indus' annual flow is about 243 cubic kilometres. It is the longest river of Pakistan.

3. Ustad Ahmad Lahori was the chief architect of Taj Mahal, in Agra, India. He hailed from Lahore.

4. John Kennedy was known for his eloquent and inspirational speeches. He was a popular US President.

5. The first country to recognise Pakistan is The Islamic republic of Iran. It is our neighbouring country.

6. My uncle's car is the envoy of my friends. It is a sporty red convertible with bucket seats.

7. The chief surgeon took his daughter on a hospital tour. He is an expert in in organ transplant procedures.

8. The problem delayed the entire program. It was that you did not come on time.

9. The worry troubles me too much. It is who we should invite.

10. Hamad is very dear to me. He is my younger brother.

E. Noun Clauses

Noun clauses are dependent clauses that can replace any noun in the sentence: subjects, objects, and/or subject complements. In all, there are five different functions that a noun clause can serve: subjects, direct objects, indirect objects, objects of the preposition and subject complements.

Using the noun clauses given at the end, complete the following sentences:

1. The prize will be given to ________.

2. Do you know ________?

3. I don't understand ________.

4. ________ made his friends angry.

5. ________ astonished her teachers.

6. ________ was not very agreeable.

7. The food inspector checked ________.

8. She did not know ________.

9. His problem was ________.

10. Hammad's great achievement at school was ________.

11. The teacher is not responsible for ________.

12. The money will go to ________.

13. It's very disappointing ________.

14. They are perfectly happy ________.

15. Umair runs so fast ________.

sections.content:
D. Combine the following sentences by placing nouns and noun phrases in apposition.

1. The first prime Minister of Pakistan was assassinated in 1951. He was Liaqat Ali Khan.

2. The river Indus' annual flow is about 243 cubic kilometres. It is the longest river of Pakistan.

3. Ustad Ahmad Lahori was the chief architect of Taj Mahal, in Agra, India. He hailed from Lahore.

4. John Kennedy was known for his eloquent and inspirational speeches. He was a popular US President.

5. The first country to recognise Pakistan is The Islamic republic of Iran. It is our neighbouring country.

6. My uncle's car is the envoy of my friends. It is a sporty red convertible with bucket seats.

7. The chief surgeon took his daughter on a hospital tour. He is an expert in in organ transplant procedures.

8. The problem delayed the entire program. It was that you did not come on time.

9. The worry troubles me too much. It is who we should invite.

10. Hamad is very dear to me. He is my younger brother.

E. Noun Clauses

Noun clauses are dependent clauses that can replace any noun in the sentence: subjects, objects, and/or subject complements. In all, there are five different functions that a noun clause can serve: subjects, direct objects, indirect objects, objects of the preposition and subject complements.

Using the noun clauses given at the end, complete the following sentences:

1. The prize will be given to ________.

2. Do you know ________?

3. I don't understand ________.

4. ________ made his friends angry.

5. ________ astonished her teachers.

6. ________ was not very agreeable.

7. The food inspector checked ________.

8. She did not know ________.

9. His problem was ________.

10. Hammad's great achievement at school was ________.

11. The teacher is not responsible for ________.

12. The money will go to ________.

13. It's very disappointing ________.

14. They are perfectly happy ________.

15. Umair runs so fast ________.
